heroTitle: Make treatment easier for your patients with Takere
heroText: We are a research group focused on helping healthcare teams keep patients engaged in their treatment with a simple platform for personalizing care plans.
mission:
Our goal is to ensure that patient treatment information reaches them and improves
your adherence to treatment
steps: Healthcare teams can easily put together a care plan.
The patient interacts at home with an app designed exclusively for their care plan.
Healthcare teams are able to remotely monitor and intervene in patient treatment.
screenAlts: takere treatment interface in mobile application
researchText: Our research group is based at the Institute of Informatics of the <ufrgs>Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul</ufrgs>. In addition, we maintain an ongoing partnership with the <hcpa>Hospital de Clínicas de Porto Alegre</hcpa>. Our research is interdisciplinary and involves students from computer science and health sciences, with the goal of studying techniques to improve healthcare.
researchMore: Be sure to <research>check out more details about our research</research>. If you are a student or researcher and are interested in contributing to the improvement of healthcare, <contact>join our research team</contact>!
teamText: Our team emerged with the dream of building the easiest platform for building and managing custom mHealth applications. Our goal is to make patients feel supported during treatment and to provide healthcare teams with the tools to become more agile and flexible in remote care.
